subject: SIG starter + BAA questions — next actions and timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@healthnova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: SIG starter + BAA questions — next actions and timeline

Hi Lisa — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can kick off the SIG/CAIQ work on our side: 

- Attachments: I'm including a SIG starter workbook (redwood_SIG_starter_v1.xlsx) and a short README (redwood_SIG_readme.pdf) that explains the evidence types we usually map. Please confirm your preferred intake format (CAIQ spreadsheet vs custom form).
- SOC 2: Can you confirm whether HealthNova has a SOC 2 Type II report in place today, or if there's a target report date? If there is a Type II in progress, approximate period covered and expected completion date would be helpful.
- PHI / HIPAA: You mentioned PHI in our call — do you require a signed BAA before sharing evidence? If so, do you have a standard BAA we should review, or should our legal send Redwood's BAA?
- Data residency / hosting: Any strict data residency requirements we should be aware of (EU/US regions or customer-specific restrictions)?
- Evidence owner: Who on your side will be the primary owner for filling CAIQ items and uploading artifacts? (Name + email is fine.)
- Timeline: Does a 2-week intake window work for you to return the prefills and/or point us to evidence in Drive? If you need longer, let us know expected dates.

Next steps I propose: I can upload the starter workbook to a shared Drive if you prefer, and schedule a 30-min intake call to walk the questionnaire and evidence mapping. If you want Redwood legal to start the BAA conversation, I can loop our legal contact.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation on the bullets above so we can assign on our side.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_SIG_starter_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_SIG_readme.pdf (pdf)

From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@healthnova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Cho <a.cho@healthnova.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG starter + BAA questions — next actions and timeline

Hi Karthik — great to chat, thanks for the follow-up and the starter files. Quick answers below and we attached a short contacts CSV with our owners.

- SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type II in-progress; fieldwork completed for Q2 and report expected in late August 2027 (external auditor: NorthBridge). We can share the SOC 2 bridge letter and the report once available.
- BAA / PHI: Yes — we process PHI for a small group of customers and require an executed BAA before exchanging PHI evidence. We don't have a BAA template; please send Redwood's standard BAA and I'll route to Legal.
- CAIQ vs custom: CAIQ spreadsheet is fine for us. Our security team prefers CAIQ v4 mapping; we'll own the answers but will need to attach evidence from our drive.
- Evidence owner: Primary owners in our team are: Lisa Tran (lisa.tran@healthnova.com) and Aaron Cho (a.cho@healthnova.com).
- Data residency: All customer data is hosted in US regions only; no EU residency requirements for this deal.
- Timeline: 2 weeks for an intake prefilling/pointing to evidence is feasible — target to have the CAIQ prefills and initial artifacts by Aug 16, 2027.

Can you confirm Redwood's BAA and whether you can provision a shared Drive folder for evidence upload? I can also set up an intake meeting for Aug 4 or Aug 5 in the morning PST.

Best,
Lisa
Head of Information Security
HealthNova

Attachments: healthnova_SIG_contact_list.csv (csv)

If Legal flags anything unusual on the BAA, we'll escalate. Otherwise we should be able to meet the Aug 16 preferred evidence target Lisa mentioned.

— Monica
